'''Izzat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] involved in the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Kaine Paulsen]]. Izzat was later killed in reprisal by Paulsen's son [[Drake Paulsen]] and his associates, [[Nikaede Celso]], [[Thaddeus Ross]] and [[Tait Ransom]]. At the moment of his death, Izzat was working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and, as a result, the Empire offered high [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] for the heads of Izzat's murderers.
